errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are not sorted ("няма... подредени стълбове"). The bars are visibly sorted in ascending order of their percentage value from top to bottom.

errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and contradicts the visual evidence. The categories on the vertical axis are sorted according to their quantitative value (the percentage), in ascending order.
